args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

Gideon, here's the draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from #inc-vtg-hartford (Aug 3, 2026):

Incident summary: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks (Aug 3, 2026)
- First reported: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open items: the status page is still not accessible for Mateo's account (separate issue, tracked under INC-4821). Scheduling continued from the dispatch office throughout. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for reconnect testing, and the reconnect log went to Odile.

Notes: the 10:42 timestamp is the first report in the incident room. Anything reported before that elsewhere isn't visible to me. Also, the incident room doesn't say whether kiosk 2 was confirmed working separately, so the 11:07 line covers both lanes as Gideon posted it.

Gideon, correction to my draft: the status-page line overstates what the channel shows. At 11:08 you said you were still chasing status-page access for Mateo's account (screenshot on INC-4821). The channel doesn't say whether that was resolved afterwards, so please confirm before it goes to procurement. The 11:07 both-lanes confirmation is as you posted it.

FINAL: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident summary (Aug 3, 2026), for Mateo Quiroga's procurement team. Prepared for Ruth Calloway.

Timeline
- 10:42 AM: first report in the incident room. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in ran on paper; scheduling continued from the dispatch office.
- 10:51 AM: Odile Brandt (Carrowmere Cloud) said Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route and asked that kiosk 2 stay powered on for reconnect attempts.
- 11:03 AM: kiosk 1 back. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- 11:07 AM: both lanes confirmed working (per Gideon Sato).

Open items
- Status-page access for Mateo's account: still being chased as of 11:08 AM. Tracked in INC-4821, which holds the screenshot. The incident room does not confirm whether this has been resolved, so treat it as open until confirmed.
- Reconnect log was sent to Odile Brandt.

Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3, 2026. Times are as posted in that channel.

FINAL summary is posted in #strategic-random as its own message, starting with "FINAL:". It adds Odile's gateway-route check at 10:51 AM and the INC-4821 tracking for status-page access. It keeps the open status-page item flagged, since the channel doesn't confirm it was resolved.
